tex_content.label: Rineq
tex_content.html:
Proof

↗ bcbd ↗ 2ndmfdconv ↗ blowupposcurv ↗ partialflowlimit ↗ lem:curvature-control-canonical-nbhd \sketch Along a spatial arclength path, the canonical-neighborhood estimate $|R'|\le CR^{3/2}$ gives

\begin{equation} R(y)\le \frac{16}{9}(R(z)+r_0^{-2}). \end{equation}

Along a vertical flow line, $|R'|\le CR^2$; the three cases according to the closed set where $R\ge r_0^{-2}$ give respectively the bounds $r_0^{-2}$, $16r_0^{-2}/15$, and $2(R(z)+r_0^{-2})$, using the lengths $r_0^2/(16C)$ and $\Delta t$.

□

Corollary
[Uniform curvature bound on a backward parabolic neighborhood]

dependencies.title: 2ndmfdconv
dependencies.description:
\label{2ndmfdconv}

Suppose that $\{(M_k,g_k,x_k)\}_{k=1}^\infty$ is a sequence of based, connected
Riemannian manifolds. Suppose that the first two conditions in
Theorem~\ref{thm:manifold-convergence-complete-limit} hold and suppose also that there are constants $\kappa>0$
and $\delta>0$ such that $\Vol_{g_k}B(x_k,\delta)\ge \kappa\delta^n$ for
all $k$. Then after passing to a subsequence there is a geometric limit which
is a complete Riemannian manifold.
\end{corollary}
